selectionRule: Per course, in every course of the five institutions where the model ranks students better than chance (AUC > 0.5): among flagged students (top 20 % risk of the course), the students closest to the 75th and 25th percentiles of self_tau; plus, from the lower half of the course's risk ranking, the student closest to the 75th percentile. A course with fewer such students gives the ones it has. Risk ranks use midranks for ties; self_tau ties are broken by a seeded shuffle (seed 0). Students without a defined self_tau are never picked.
